title: Qualified Nurse
description:
Suhaib Pharmacy is a trusted community pharmacy located in Nokonjeru, dedicated to providing quality pharmaceutical and healthcare services. We are looking for a Qualified and Experienced Nurse to join our professional healthcare team.

**Position: Qualified Nurse**

**Requirements:**
- Qualified and experienced nurse with valid registration
- Must hold a valid nursing license from the relevant regulatory body
- Previous clinical or pharmacy nursing experience preferred
- Strong patient care and communication skills
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team

**Benefits:**
- Competitive salary: 300,000 UGX per month
- Allowance: Medication covered
- Lunch provided: 100,000 UGX worth
- Sunday off: Enjoy every Sunday off

**Why Join Us?**
- Supportive, professional healthcare team
- Clean and modern pharmacy environment
- Opportunity for professional growth and training
- Work-life balance with guaranteed Sundays off
- Be part of a trusted community pharmacy serving Nokonjeru

**Working Hours:**
Monday to Saturday, 8:00am - 6:00pm
Sunday: Off

**How to Apply:**
Submit your CV and credentials to Suhaib Pharmacy Nokonjeru
- Contact: 0757 590 599
- Email: careers@suhaibpharmacy.example
- Visit us: Suhaib Pharmacy, Nokonjeru

Applications open now. Suhaib Pharmacy is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
